visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair lies in a bed with light grey sheets and white pillows, wearing a white t-shirt. The setting is a dimly lit bedroom with warm ambient light emanating from a recessed shelf in the headboard. He appears distressed and looks around with a tight facial expression. (2) A figure with long, messy black hair and a pale, grey-toned face appears hovering directly over the man. The man remains prone, looking up with fear. The background is slightly blurred but remains the same bedroom setting. (3) The man sits up abruptly in bed, rubbing his head and neck. A woman in a white t-shirt and matching shorts enters through a doorway into the bedroom. The lighting shifts to brighter, natural-looking indoor illumination. (4) The woman stands by the bed talking to the man, who sits on the edge. A ghost-like figure is visible behind them, partially obscured, holding a long grey bolster pillow. (5) A promotional sequence begins with the woman speaking directly to the camera in a brightly lit indoor environment. She holds and demonstrates various grey fabric bedding items. The man is shown in cutaway shots sleeping peacefully under a light blue cooling sheet. (6) Blooper segments show the man, the woman, and a third individual in ghost makeup laughing and interacting in the bedroom set. Crew members and mobile phones used for filming are visible.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator, 1 female lead (girlfriend), and 1 female in ghost makeup (potentially the same female lead or a crew member).
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The man wears a white t-shirt with a small fox logo. The woman wears a simple white t-shirt and white shorts.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern bedroom with a large headboard featuring built-in warm lighting, grey and white bedding, and light-colored walls. Some scenes feature a simple white studio-like wall for product explanation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Low eerie BGM starts with subtle dissonant tones. A male voice speaks with low intensity and hesitant prosody, sounding like a private thought. (2) Rhythmic vocal chanting in a mid-pitch male voice begins, accompanied by soft bedsheet rustling. (3) A sharp 'ding' SFX marks a transition. Upbeat, fast-tempo acoustic pop BGM begins (~115 BPM). A female voice enters with high pitch and energetic, friendly tone. (4) Multiple layers of dialogue: female voice narrating product specs and male voice reacting. High speech density. Occasional 'whoosh' SFX for scene transitions. (5) Loud, high-arousal laughter from multiple individuals marks the start of the blooper section. Ambient studio noise increases slightly as the music volume ducks. (6) Final comedic stinger with a sharp vocal 'hihi' and upbeat final chords of the BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Reveal -> Product Demonstration -> CTA -> Bloopers
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote 'Mian Dou Fu' brand cooling sheets and pillows using a humorous and relatable 'ghost' story that transitions into a product benefit explanation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly demonstrates and discusses the features and price of 'Mian Dou Fu' products with branding on screen.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A creatively structured ad that uses a common cultural trope (ghost month) to highlight the 'cooling' feature of the bedding.
